title: The ocean is more mysterious than you think 🌊
hook: Wait! The ocean hides secrets that feel like they're from another planet.

scenes.narration: Wait! The ocean hides secrets that feel like they're from another planet.
If you dropped Mount Everest into the Mariana Trench, there would still be more than a mile of water above it.
And this is incredible! At least half of the oxygen you breathe comes from the ocean, thanks to tiny ocean plants.
scenes.on_screen_text: Half our oxygen comes from the sea

scenes.narration: But wait, it gets stranger: only about a quarter of the seafloor has been mapped in detail.
scenes.on_screen_text: Only 1/4 of the seafloor is mapped

scenes.narration: Wow! And the biggest animal that ever lived isn't a dinosaur: it's the blue whale, and it's alive today.
Which ocean mystery should I look into next? Tell me in the comments and follow me.

description: Everest fits inside the Mariana Trench, half our oxygen comes from the sea and only a quarter of the seafloor is mapped. Which mystery is next?

sources.title: How much oxygen comes from the ocean?

claims.statement: La fosa de las Marianas mide casi 11.000 m; el Everest 8.849 m.
Al menos la mitad del oxígeno de la Tierra proviene del océano.
Solo alrededor de una cuarta parte del fondo marino está cartografiado en alta resolución.
La ballena azul es el animal más grande que ha existido.
